patches.why_not_vispy: glue-qt imports QtQuick and selects Qt Quick's OpenGL graphics API at startup; vispy cannot change that.

upstream.reason: Upstream selects the OpenGL graphics API so WebEngine can run beside its OpenGL widget (QTBUG-122886); the hot swap runs stock glue-qt and passes both gates with it (W13).

patches.strict_only: glue_qt/utils/app.py: no QtQuick import or OpenGL graphics-API selection; pyproject.toml, PKG-INFO and glue_qt.egg-info/PKG-INFO: AGPL licence fields.

patches.why_not_vispy: glue-vispy-viewers refuses to import without PyOpenGL and declares pyopengl and glfw; vispy cannot change that.

upstream.reason: Not part of W12: the hot swap runs stock glue-vispy-viewers, whose PyOpenGL import the audit records as host activity; an upstream change would need its own approval.
